title: Tropicalization and degeneration of short flag varieties and their fibers
summary: Tropicalizations of Grassmannians resp. flag varieties parametrizing (flags of) linear spaces have been studied intensely and reveal rich combinatorial structure. Linear degenerations of flag varieties provide ways of interpolating between products of Grassmannians and flag varieties. Tropical versions of these have been introduced recently, but their combinatorial description and computation remains a challenge.
